text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. First, make a clear plan and break big tasks into smaller steps. Then prioritise: decide which tasks are most important and do them first. It is also wise to manage your scope, which means being realistic about how much work you can finish in the time you have. Don't add extra tasks at the last minute. Finally, communicate with your team or teacher. If you see a problem, speak up early instead of waiting. People usually understand when you tell them in advance. With planning, focus, and honest communication, you can meet deadlines with less stress.
